title: Father taking jobs out of town and leaving her mother waiting
summary: Harold prompts a story: father would tell her mother to meet him at work, then take another job elsewhere and write from Tennessee.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did you tell me about your father when you tell your mother to come get the money?

Oh, my daddy would tell her to come meet him at the place where he worked and she would go on there to meet him and he wouldn't be there. And the next couple of days she would get a letter from him. He was in Tennessee or some other place. He had gone and taken another job. Yeah. She wouldn't know a thing about it.
